question.text: Multiple on Invested Capital (MOIC) equals TVPI when:

answer.text: The fund has just completed its first close
The fund is in its vintage year
All capital calls have been met (i.e., Total Invested Capital = Total Paid-In Capital)

explanation.text: The Logic: Ch 9.7.4.4: When all capital calls are met, Total Invested Capital = Total Paid-In Capital, and TVPI equals MOIC. The Trap: Option A is too early. Option C has low PIC, hence TVPI and MOIC would differ materially. Option B says no distributions made yet, doesn't equate the two. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B tests TVPI=MOIC at full drawdown; XXI-B similar.
